name: style_mix
author: sc3kre
description: All three building styles grow side by side at random: every European (set e523f3fb) and Asian (set 6523f3d5) building that re-skins a zoned building is added as a NEW building (id + 400000 / id + 1500000) next to the North American one, so nothing stock is replaced. Keep the in-game building style at the default.
